apply-config.label: Applying settings
apply-config.description: Saves the new values to homelab.env and re-runs install.sh, which updates every app that uses them.

backup.label: Backing up
backup.description: Stops each running app, copies containers/ to backup/containers/<date>, and starts them again.

update.label: Updating
update.description: Pulls the latest version of this repository, re-runs install.sh, then restarts adlerOS so it runs the new version.
